llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it claims: provide code patterns and guidance for embedding Mermaid diagrams in HTML. It recommends loading mermaid from the jsDelivr CDN — which is normal for web projects but is an external network dependency; if you need an auditable or offline setup, host the Mermaid library from a trusted internal source instead. The provided code examples focus on the DOM and error handling (not on accessing secrets), so there is low risk from installing the skill itself. Note: the code snippets are implementation guidance and may need minor adjustments for your environment (mermaid.parse behavior and unique ID generation). If you require stricter supply-chain guarantees, ask the author for a pinned release URL or bundle the library yourself.
